note: Machine-readable benchmark measurements and provenance used by the README and figures.

durham_hamilton8.allocation: 1 node, 1 task, 1 CPU, 8 GiB; process pinned to logical CPU 121

measurement_scope: Each row is a single measured run. There are no repeated runs and no per-seed distributions, so no confidence intervals are available.
Latency percentiles are the measured distribution within a run and are the only variability reported.
Timings are specific to the disclosed host. Direct latency or throughput comparison across uncontrolled hosts is not supported by these measurements.
Guard checksums are deterministic for a fixed input. The blocking SPSC policy guarantees zero drops; checksum parity held on all six measured SPSC corpora.
Allocation counts are a property of the build and the allocation tracker rather than of the timing environment; the cross-host verification below records where they were reproduced.
The CPU governor and turbo state were not controllable from the non-root Slurm job.
LLC performance counters were unsupported for this allocation and are therefore absent.

cross_host_verification.method: run_pooled_stress_benchmarks.py re-run on unrelated hardware with a different iteration count.
observations: Allocations per event matched the Durham figures to six decimal places on all eight stress corpora.
Guard checksums matched between the standard and pooled variants on all eight corpora.
The pooled path recorded zero allocations on all eight corpora.
Latency and throughput differed, as expected for host-dependent quantities.

reproduction.corpora: python scripts/generate_synthetic_events.py (seeds and modes in corpus_manifest.csv)

corpus_manifest.csv.description: Generation parameters and SHA-256 checksum of every deterministic corpus used above.

hot_path_1m_standard_vs_pooled.csv.description: Standard and opt-in pooled L3 hot path over the 1M high-cancellation corpus, five measured iterations each.

inference_replay_loop.csv.description: Replay event loop with and without LinearModel inference over the 10k balanced corpus, plus standalone inference-support rows.

perf_counters.csv.description: Linux perf stat counters collected around whole benchmark processes. LLC events were unsupported on this host.

public_l2_onnx_inference.json.description: Isolated ONNX Runtime inference cost for the recorded-public-L2 model-contract artefact, measured on a separate host.

spsc_steady_state_1m.csv.description: Single-thread and opt-in SPSC steady-state replay throughput over six 1M corpora, with backpressure, drops and checksum parity.

stress_corpora_standard_vs_pooled.csv.description: Paired standard and pooled hot-path rows over eight small stress corpora, with guard-checksum parity.
